scope: RSS description URI resolution; this template transforms generated article HTML URLs and does not sanitize arbitrary HTML.

sources.supports: Absolute URLs in item descriptions avoid aggregators resolving relative references against the channel link.
Hugo returns a Go url.URL structure for relative or absolute references.
Resolve URI references against each item permalink rather than the site root.
Whitespace delimits URL tokens; embedded commas can belong to a candidate URL, including data URLs.
URL parsing removes leading/trailing C0 controls and ASCII spaces and strips ASCII tabs/newlines; percent escapes and non-ASCII spaces remain significant.

implementation_limits: Rewrites the navigation/media attributes actually emitted by this site; it is not a general HTML sanitizer.
Raw script/style/pre/code/textarea blocks, comments, CSS references and SVG use/defs references remain literal.
The srcset helper preserves this site’s URL plus width/density-descriptor candidates, including data URLs; it does not validate malformed descriptors.
Expected relative references are compared with Node’s independent WHATWG URL parser in regression fixtures.
